equivalence: Same floor((received endpoint-current sharedmap origin)/0.05) cell; original endpoints are cellcentres. Not groupID, adjacency radius, geometry truth or an entire frontier region.
within_snapshot: Union crossrobot sameendpoint pairs into original candidate_conflicts; original conditional masks and maximum-participation rule remain authoritative.
across_snapshots: Filter original action_mask for candidates sharing a cell with another robot owned pending/active proposal; update existing valid_counts and wait_mask. Original candidates, generation, order, positions, map and KEEP semantics retained.
acquisition: Only after original Allocator.apply returns actual pending proposal, store robot/tasktoken/selectedsharedendpoint before the unchanged sendGoal path.
release: Only original Allocator.finish returnsTrue for matching robot/tasktoken; original UUID/realterminal handling unchanged. No release on cancelrequest, stop, mapversion change or elapsedTTL.
concurrency: Same existing HQ RLock encloses original method plus adapter state.
scope: Explicit literalA0 over q+footprintprevention only. No PPO weights/701codec, candidate generation, controller/geometry/radii/padding, clock, freshness,120sim or original collision/stop/copy changes.
limitations: An idle robot may legitimately WAIT if all already-legal candidates are reserved. This does not guarantee coverage or useful alternative candidates; old results are not exact replay. Physical endpoint/route/peer guards remain independently enforced.
